meta.name: 100 Days of Deception
meta.description: Hoping for freedom, Gyeongseong's top pickpocket infiltrates the Japanese colonial government to steal secrets — only to fall for her target's son.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Pickpocket Lee Ga-kyung has just one goal — to flee colonial Joseon. But she soon ends up unexpectedly entangled with the Korean independence movement.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Ga-kyung's language skills shock Yoo Philip and Yoo So-ran. Meanwhile, Kim Tae-ung's insistence that Ga-kyung return his wallet raises her suspicions.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Despite Ga-kyung's initial reservations about So-ran, the two join hands. On her first day at work undercover, Ga-kyung meets a familiar face.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Tae-ung remains suspicious of Ga-kyung, but also strangely captivated — or even charmed? Meanwhile, the Gugukdan start making big plans.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Asked to translate for an interrogation, Ga-kyung struggles when she recognizes the man being questioned. Tae-ung's feelings grow increasingly conflicted.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Sato Shinichi confronts his past. As the interrogation escalates, so do Ga-kyung's fears — leading her to find unexpected solace in Tae-ung.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Tae-ung confides in Ga-kyung about his hidden family past, bringing the two closer together. Meanwhile, Ga-kyung makes some discoveries of her own.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Fuzzy about the details of their shared night out, Ga-kyung finds herself flustered in Tae-ung's presence. Later, Tae-ung faces some harsh truths.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: The Gugukdan set their grand plan in motion. Ga-kyung musters up the courage to be honest about her feelings — only for Tae-ung to keep his distance.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: As the Gugukdan comes up against Sato, Tae-ung is forced to witness his father's cruelty first-hand. Ga-kyung has a change of heart.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Amid the chaos, Ga-kyung and Tae-ung can no longer deny their feelings. But the Gugukdan remains hostile toward Tae-ung. Just then, So-ran and Philip receive a phone call.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: As Sato and the Gugukdan launch their plans, So-ran and Philip accept a dangerous invitation. Ga-kyung and Tae-ung face a battle that will decide their fate.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Sato and the Gugukdan have nowhere left to turn. Sato’s ruthless schemes leave the group and Ga-kyung cornered. Meanwhile, Tae-ung receives a crucial mission from Sato.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Ga-kyung, Tae-ung, and the Gugukdan launch a major counterattack against Sato, but a shocking truth no one expected emerges just as they finally celebrate their victory together.
